name: ToHeart2 Dungeon Travelers
original_name: ToHeart2 ダンジョントラベラーズ
source:
After Maryan's science experiment, the To Heart 2 characters are thrown into a fantasy RPG world, and they learn that the only way to return to their normal lives is to find and defeat the final boss.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/To_Heart_2:_Dungeon_Travelers]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
在玛丽安的科学实验之后，《To Heart 2》中的角色被扔进了一个奇幻RPG世界，他们了解到恢复正常生活的唯一方法就是找到并击败最终的Boss。

[来自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/To_Heart_2:_Dungeon_Travelers]维基百科[/url]]
